data.rationale: The proposal is a hardcoded click sequence built around Central Park, with an Italian filter and unrelated clicks (price button, Next, attractions tabs), so it misses the search-box typing and location selection. It names no parameters, so it can't be automated for arbitrary locations or filters. It only partly overlaps with the true workflow: open restaurants, then show more, pick a filter label, and Apply.
